regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, DOI, and SI availability statement

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 structures, six catalyst conditions, ORTEP, and footnote
regions.finding: Six independent catalyst experiments were retained with common charges/conditions and paired crude-NMR 4aa/5aaa yields. Au(SIPr)/morpholine is merged with Table 2 3a because conditions and 27%/66% outcomes are identical. ORTEP CCDC 2074504 is catalyst characterization, not a reaction.

Ten amine rows were reconciled. The 3a row merges with Table 1 Au(SIPr); 3f later merges with Table 3 TFE and Table 4 Au(SIPr). n.d. outcomes and the 3.3:1 d.r. footnote are preserved. The footnote's printed 3a (0.24 mmol) is not silently transferred to all substituted amines.

regions.finding: Twenty-six distinct solvent/additive conditions were transcribed with both product yields, including numeric 0 for DMSO, ETFA alone, and ETFA plus 2 equiv/0.4 mmol TFE. TFE is merged with the identical optimized 3f run. Row-specific d.r. values occur only in unassociated Table S1 and remain missing.
Catalyst-screen failures and scope classes are narrative pointers to page-3 rows; no prose-only duplicates were created.

Cu/Zn rows preserve n.d. allene outcomes, 5aaf yields, and d.r.; CdI2 retains 1% 4aa. The reaction drawing says 3f while the footnote prints 3a, and both source statements remain explicit.

All displayed current-method scope conditions were transcribed row by row, including footnote time/temperature overrides, the distinct 25 °C and 60 °C 4ua runs, and the separate 50 mmol/11.0 g 4km scale-up.
Four current Au-method rows and four cited ZnI2 previous-method rows were kept separate. Prior-method yields are classified as literature examples, not current experiments.

The text identifies four 4km transformations, the 1y/2p formal-synthesis route, CuBr preparation of two 5aaf diastereomers, aldehyde-effect controls, and deuterium labeling. Detailed arrows are on page 4 and are linked rather than duplicated.

regions.finding: Four independent application experiments were retained. The 4km→(E)-6 and 4km→9 records preserve ordered two-stage conditions and overall yields rather than assigning them to only the final stage; hydration and Suzuki coupling remain separate experiments.

The graphical 0 °C-to-room-temperature 4 h preparation of 2p, the 1y+2p ATA to 4yp, and the cited three-step Ref. 9 conversion to centrolobine are three separate records. The cited final sequence is literature work.

One two-product CuBr A3 coupling, three aldehyde-effect 1,5-H-transfer entries, one deuterated-amine experiment, and one undeuterated control were retained. NMR yield, isolated yield, recovery, and D incorporation remain distinct product-targeted outcomes.
Two amine-structure controls and two 5aae'/inhibition controls were retained row by row, including source dashes, NMR yields, recoveries, and the 2.7:1 d.r. footnote.
DFT discussion is classified as mechanistic computation, not a reaction experiment.
